english: We are in your debt, Lord Dragon.
chinese: 神龙大人，多谢你的帮助。

english: Thief?
chinese: 贼？

english: No.  It's where it's always been.
chinese: 不，它一直在老地方。

english: It's in Serpentholm.
chinese: 它在 Serpentholm。

english: And once they'd finished their filthy business, I hid the Orb in the courtyard pool.
chinese: 等他们办完那些见不得人的事，我就把宝珠藏进了庭院的水池。

english: Only the wisest turn over the same stone twice.
chinese: 只有最明智的人，才会把同一块石头移开两次。

english: It's safe where it is.
chinese: 它待在那里很安全。

english: It's at Serpentholm.
chinese: 它在 Serpentholm。

english: And after they'd finished their filthy business, I hid the Orb in the courtyard pool.
chinese: 等他们办完那些见不得人的事，我就把宝珠藏进了庭院的水池。

english: Only the wisest turn over the same stone twice.
chinese: 只有最明智的人，才会把同一块石头移开两次。

english: We thought you dead, honorable prince.
chinese: 尊贵的王子，我们以为你已经死了。

english: Look there!
chinese: 看那边！

english: More are on the way.  They come seeking the Orb.
chinese: 还有更多人正在赶来。他们是冲着宝珠来的。

english: Kenji...we thought you were dead.
chinese: Kenji……我们以为你已经死了。

english: More are coming - look there!
chinese: 还有人来了——看那边！

english: Welcome back, honorable Prince.
chinese: 欢迎归来，尊贵的王子。

english: My name is Yumi.
chinese: 我叫 Yumi。

english: I will be your guide as you reacquaint yourself with your homeland.
chinese: 我会带你重新熟悉自己的故土。

english: Much has changed since you left and the road to restoration will be long indeed.
chinese: 你离开后，这里发生了许多变化，重建之路也会十分漫长。

english: Someone awaits your arrival in the clearing to the North.
chinese: 北面的空地上有人在等你。

english: Let's meet them and start rebuilding your empire.
chinese: 我们去见他们，然后开始重建你的帝国。

english: Before we can move, we'll have to select Kenji.
chinese: 出发前，先选中 Kenji。

english: Left-click Kenji to select him.
chinese: 左键点击 Kenji，选中他。

english: Good!
chinese: 很好！

english: Now that he's selected, Right-click where you want him to go and he'll walk there.
chinese: 选中他后，在目的地点击右键，他就会走过去。

english: If you want to unselect Kenji, Left-click something else or Left-click the ground.
chinese: 要取消选中 Kenji，就左键点击别的对象或地面。

english: We've arrived.
chinese: 我们到了。

english: This was once peaceful Issen village.
chinese: 这里曾是宁静的 Issen 村。

english: Do you remember it?
chinese: 你还记得这里吗？

english: It used to be one of our most beautiful towns, but the Lotus destroyed it five years ago.
chinese: 它曾是我们最美的村镇之一，但 5 年前被莲花族摧毁了。

english: This Peasant, Sperri, has been waiting for your return.
chinese: 这位农民叫 Sperri，一直在等你回来。

english: He's eager to serve you and rebuild his town.
chinese: 他很想为你效力，重建自己的村庄。

english: Select him.
chinese: 选中他。

english: Left-clicking someone selects them, remember?
chinese: 还记得吗？左键点击一个人就能选中他。

english: Sperri can only build the buildings you see at the bottom of the screen.
chinese: Sperri 只能建造屏幕下方显示的建筑。

english: As you can see, he can only build a Peasant Hut right now.
Left-click on the Peasant Hut icon, then place the hut by right-clicking somewhere on the ground.
chinese: 左键点击农舍图标，再在地面上选一处位置点击右键，建造农舍。

english: If you decide you don't want to build the Hut right now, Left-click to cancel or to select something else.
You can only build on relatively flat terrain, so plan carefully, my Lord.
Excellent, the hut is complete!
Remember, Left-click always selects and Right-click always performs actions.
To continue building the hut, select your Peasant and Right-click on the framework we've already started.
Look!  A new peasant has emerged from the hut we built.
Peasants appear from within the huts automatically.
Your village can only support a certain number of people at a time, indicated in the lower left corner of the screen.
Also, the bigger your current population is the slower the Peasant birthrate will be.
If you watch the bar at the bottom left of the screen, you can tell when the next peasant will arrive.
When the bar is full, a Peasant will appear.
Do you see the golden Peasant button in the center interface?
This is the Idle Peasant button.
It will help you keep our Peasants busy and productive.
Left-clicking it will focus on an idle peasant and automatically select him.
Try it sometime.
If we're to grow, your people will need more food, my lord.
Whenever we construct a building or train a soldier we'll need food and drink to fuel the effort.
Let's harvest some rice from this rice field over here.
Let's select all of our Peasants.
Move the cursor near the Peasants.
Press and hold the left mouse button.
As you move the mouse, you will see a box expand from the cursor.
Drag the cursor until the box encompasses all of the Peasants.
Release the mouse button and the Peasants will be selected.
You can select any of your people in this manner.
This will be crucial to commanding your army effectively, so learn it well.
Now, scroll to the rice field and Right-click on one of the rice plants in the field.
This will tell the Peasants to start harvesting, and they will continue to do so until told differently.
Rice is important, but our people will also need fresh water to drink.
A pond or stream like this one should do nicely.
Select our Peasants, then scroll to the pond and Right-click it.
Excellent!
We're almost ready to start building our army!
To train warriors, we'll need a Dojo.
Select some Peasants.
Notice the Dojo is now available in the build menu.
We'll find a good spot and build the Dojo just like we built the Peasant Hut.
The more peasants we have selected the faster our new Dojo will be completed.
Also, if you hold the right mouse button down and drag left and right we can rotate the building.
When you let go of the button, the building will be placed.
My lord, we must complete our Dojo.
Select some Peasants and Right-click on the Dojo you started to complete it.
Now we'll train our first warrior, a Spearman.
Training a Spearman will cost you rice and water.
Uh oh! We're out of rice!
And look, the fields are dry!
Don't worry, my lord - we can harvest more rice if we water the field.
Select some peasants like we did before.
In the lower right corner of the build interface you'll see the blue Water Rice icon.
Left-click the Water Rice icon, and Right-click one of the depleted rice plants.
In no time the field will be ready for harvesting again - go ahead and tell a Peasant to harvest rice.
Well done! The fields are fertile again and our rice stores have been replenished.
Looks like we'll need some more water, though.
Select a Peasant and order him to harvest some water for us, my lord.
Now, back to training that Spearman…
Select a peasant and Right-click on the Dojo.
This will command the Peasant to enter and train in that building.
Your first soldier will be ready soon, my Lord.
You can see how long the training will take by Left-clicking the building and looking at the growing blue line.
Congratulations!
Having learned the economic basics, it's time to learn more about building our army.
Rest up and we'll continue tomorrow.
Welcome back.
As you can see, New Issen is coming along nicely.
If we're to protect our new town, we'll need more than one Spearman.
While you were away the townspeople built a new training building, the Target Range.
Like the Dojo, the Target Range can train Peasants into new fighters.
Instead of Spearman, however, Peasants will become skilled Archers.
...But what would happen if a Spearman were to train on the Target Range?
Select the Spearman and order him to train in the Target Range and let's see what happens.
Very interesting, indeed.
This is a Dragon Warrior, a soldier trained in both hand-to-hand and missile combat.
While he prefers to fight with his sword, he can fire magical bolts as well, making him a most versatile ally.
We call the process of training in multiple buildings 'Unit Alchemy.'
There are certain to be other buildings to train in, so experiment with different training combinations.
In theory you could train the fiercest of all warriors by training one peasant in three different buildings…!
It's important to have a good mix of warriors in our ranks because each type has different strengths and weaknesses.
We'll need to train different soldiers to adapt to our army to a variety of battle conditions.
One last thing, for now.
This is Sparrow's Song, the bathhouse I trained in.
We Geisha are skilled in many arts, but our healing abilities are the most important to you.
To produce another Geisha, send this Peasant into the Bathhouse.
What...?
Don't be silly, of course not!
That Peasant will take over the duties of one of the Geisha trainees inside, allowing her to emerge and aid you on the battlefield.
Excellent!
Good day, sister Yukako!
Unlike other clansmen, healers cannot enter other training buildings.
Likewise, our troops cannot enter the Bathhouse.
Let's rest until morning, my Lord - today's been easy enough, but tomorrow…
...Tomorrow you'll learn about combat, my most exciting lecture.
Until then…
Wake up, my Lord!
We're under attack, but where are they?
Do you see the small crossed swords icon in the center of the interface?
If you Left-click that you will be moved to any active battles that involve our forces.
Cannoneers!
And that fellow with the torch…it's a Raider!
We trained some new Dragon Warriors overnight, and they await your orders!
Quick, back to our forces!
Do you see the small map in the bottom right corner of the screen?
If you Left-click on that our view will instantly be moved to any location on the map.
The small orange dots represent our clansmen and the small red dots represent the enemy.
Left-click on the orange dots on the minimap to move back to our forces.
Select the Dragon Warriors, quickly!
You can tell your soldiers to run by double Right-clicking on the enemy.
You can also hold down the Alt key when you Right-click to command soldiers to run.
Everything's…gone.
So many are dead…
Please, let's try this again…
We're saved!
The people thank you, Lord.
Did you notice the Cannoneer couldn't fire his cannon when our warriors engaged him?
Most ranged attackers are much less effective in hand-to-hand combat.
This means that engaging them in melee combat is a good way to disable them.
Likewise, you should keep your own missile-using soldiers from engaging in melee combat.
Our Dragon Warriors have fought hard protecting us tonight, so I'll retire them for the evening.
Hopefully we won't need them any more tonight.
...What?
It would seem that I spoke too soon - Fire!
Quick, we must douse the fire!
That damned raider must have done this.
A burning building gradually breaks down.
The fiercer the flames, the faster it will burn down.
Do you see the small fire icon in the center of the interface?
Left-click it to instantly focus on the the burning building!
Oh no! Sparrow's Song is burning!
Don't worry sisters, we'll save you!
Look, a Peasant!
Select the Peasant and move the cursor over the burning building - notice the cursor changes to the 'Extinguish' cursor.
Right-click to confirm the order and your Peasant will move to extinguish these buildings.
The Peasant firefighter will gather from the nearest source of water and automatically return to douse the flames.
Even the hottest infernos can be quelled with only a few buckets of water.
Whew, that was close!
We were lucky there was a pond nearby.
To deal with fires more effectively, build towns near ponds or other sources of water.
My lord, may I humbly ask you to repair Sparrow's Song?
Please select the heroic Peasant that saved my home.
At the bottom of the interface you'll see a blue icon with a hammer icon on it.
This is the 'Repair' command.
Please select the Repair command and Right-click on the bathhouse.
Oh thank you, my lord!
I don’t think my sisters and I can ever thank you enough for your generosity.
Now we should think about New Issen's future…
My lord, I apologize for asking such an unreasonable request - please forgive me and we'll move on.
Oh dear, we didn't put it out in time…
Fortunately, all of my sisters got away safely.
Nothing in this life is permanent - there will always be other bathhouses, I suppose.
It's time we built some town defenses to prevent raids like that from happening again.
Select a Peasant.
If you look at the interface you'll see that we can now build Watchtowers.
Watchtowers are formidable defenses, but we can only support so many.
As our town grows and gains certain structures we will be able to support additional Watchtowers.
Let's build a Watchtower.
While we wait for the Watchtower to be completed, we should use the time to train an Archer.
You see, Watchtowers must be manned by soldiers to be effective.
Also, they're most useful to missile units, such as the Archer.
Excellent.
Select the new Archer and Right-click on our new Watchtower.
Once in the Watchtower, the Archer will not only be defended but also gain increased attack strength, range and sight.
Good!
In addition to their other strengths, each Watchtower has a special ability of its own.
Left-click our new Watchtower to select it.
Look in the bottom left corner of the interface.
Dragon Watchtowers use the Daze ability, but our intelligence shows that other clans' are different.
The ability can only be used when the Watchtower is charged with enough spiritual power.
This power is indicated by the Charge meter in next to the ability's activation button.
With your base defenses in order, we should strike against the enemy now.
Our scouts report that the enemies are attacking from this location.
Aha!
They made a tactical mistake!
They built their town at the base of a cliff, something we can use to our advantage.
If we attack from higher ground we will surely win!
From higher ground our attacks are stronger and we'll be defended from the enemy's assaults, just like in our Watchtowers.
Train three Archers and we'll run these scoundrels out of this province for good!
Excellent Lord, our assault team is ready!
Move our troops to the location indicated on the minimap and attack!
Excellent, the enemy has been routed!
Their hut still remains, though, and our arrows aren't very effective against buildings…
Perhaps we can crush it with these boulders on the hill?
Select one of your Archers and Right-click a boulder to push it.
The boulder will roll in the direction it is pushed, so line the Archer up with the building to push it in the right direction.
This province is finally free of those enemy scum!
Hmmm, we're out of boulders…
I guess we have no other choice - we will have to use our arrows.
This will take longer, but ultimately we will prevail.
So much happened today, and the town is still in shambles.
Please rest for tomorrow's training, my lord.
You did well and we must rebuild the town.
Until then, rest well.
Ah, much better - the town is repaired and the people can return to their daily lives.
With New Issen secure, it's time we started freeing other provinces from our enemies.
...but we're not ready for such an assault.
Let me help you prepare your forces for the coming battles.
There's much you can do to modify and improve your army's effectiveness in battle.
The most basic is mounting.
Most soldiers can ride horses into battle and get considerable advantages in battle when they do so.
Let's try giving a horse to a soldier, shall we?
Here are the Stables.
This building will domesticate wild horses and make them battle-ready.
But where do we get wild horses?
Ah, it looks like this peasant has found some.
Wild horses will always be visible on the minimap as brown dots, so keep an eye out for them.
Select him and Right-click on a horse to begin the herding process.
Befriending wild horses is not an easy task.
Once befriended, the horse will follow your peasant back to the stables.
Now that the horse has been domesticated, let's mount it.
Select this Spearman and Right-click on the Stables.
Excellent.
From atop a horse units are more resilient to melee attacks and inflict more damage in battle.
In addition, horse-using clans train these steeds with an additional attack of their own.
Select the Spearman you just mounted.
See the button underneath his portrait?
When this button is pressed, it will initiate the horse's Trample ability.
Trample deals considerable damage to any enemies that surround the horse, but will deplete some of its stamina.
Stamina is represented by the blue bar underneath each soldier's green health bar
When any soldier runs or uses an ability he will consume stamina.
Trample is effective both offensively and defensively, but your horse won't be able to run as long afterwards, so use it carefully.
Peasants can also use horses.
While they don't mount them, they can use them as packhorses to efficiently carry more resources to the Peasant Huts.
Finally, a soldier can dismount by selecting it and Left-clicking the ""Dismount"" button in the lower right portion of the interface.
That's about all there is to know about horses, my lord.
The second type of enhancement is called 'BattleGear.'
One moment, my lord…
Please give me a moment to catch my breath…
BattleGear enhance soldiers by giving them additional powers.
For example, an Archer is typically an effective anti-infantry soldier…
…But a certain BattleGear will allow him to shoot fiery arrows to destroy buildings.
The Dragon Clan gains BattleGear by training in certain buildings, but other clans may have entirely different approaches.
Select the Dragon Warrior and order him to enter the Shrine.
The Dragon Warrior is meditating inside the shrine, unlocking a power deep within himself to use in battle.
Excellent - your Dragon Warrior has gained the ability to use the 'Chi Shield.'
Now let's try using it - select the Dragon Warrior.
Do you see the  new button underneath the Dragon Warrior's portrait?
Left-click it and see what happens.
You've activated the Chi Shield.
While active, the Dragon Warrior outwardly focuses his life force to protect himself.
The concentration needed to maintain the Chi Shield renders him immobile, but he is completely impervious to damage.
As a diversionary measure, the Chi Shield is unparalleled.
Notice that his stamina is steadily depleting.
The Chi Shield can be turned off whenever you wish, but will automatically dissipate when the Dragon Warrior's stamina is depleted.
Not all BattleGear use stamina.
Some have unlimited use, some have strict limitations and some even consume the user's health.
For more information a BattleGear's function, place your cursor over the button and check the tooltip on the left side of the screen.
Each warrior type gets different abilities from the BattleGear buildings, so experiment and try training a variety of units.
On to the final improvement type.
During the previous battles, you were blessed with some points of Yang.
These tokens of spiritual power are earned through battle.
The better our forces fight the faster we'll earn them.
As a noble and enlightened clan, we received points of Yang.
These are denoted by the white tokens to the left of the interface's central Yin Yang icon.
Darker clans, like our Serpent attackers, accrue black tokens of Yin.
Once acquired, we can focus Yang to improve our forces' battle prowess.
Select the Dojo by Left-clicking it.
My lord, this is the Target Range.
The Dojo is the building on the left.
Please select the Dojo so you can continue to learn about techniques.
You'll notice on the right side of the interface two icons.
Each of these is a 'Technique,' an enhancement purchased with Yin or Yang.
Unlike BattleGear, which only improves an individual, Techniques upgrade entire ranks of soldiers!
By moving your mouse over these icons you can read the effects of the technique in the tooltip on the left side of the screen.
Begin learning one of these techniques by Left-clicking its icon.
I suppose there's no harm in learning one of the Target Range's techniques, my lord.
Good.
While a training building's masters meditate on the chosen technique they will be unable to admit new trainees, so plan ahead.
Excellent!
All existing Spearmen have become stronger and all future Spearmen will benefit, as well.
Effective use of Techniques can give you the edge over your opponent.
Use them wisely to complement your existing strategy.
With upgrades out of the way, we've completed your training.
Reflect on what you've learned today.
If you forget something and would like to go through these lessons again, I'd be honored to review them with you.
My lord?
Is everything all right?
Let's continue with your training, my lord.
I'll repeat what I said, in case you forgot.
My lord, we should act quickly.
My lord, the unit is needed over here.
Kenji!
chinese: Kenji！

english: We thought you were dead.
chinese: 我们以为你死了。

english: I've waited seven years to serve you, Lord Oja.
chinese: Oja 大人，我等了七年，只希望能为你效力。

english: He saved our lives!
chinese: 他救了我们的命！

english: He doesn't speak for the village.
chinese: 他不能代表整个村子说话。

english: The Serpent's Son will take tea in my house.
chinese: 灵蛇之子，请到我家坐坐。

english: He rules the provinces to the north, and would rule this one too if he could.
chinese: 他统治着北方的行省；若有机会，也会统治这里。

english: He seeks to rebuild the clan, but his methods are...questionable.
chinese: 他想重建氏族，但他的方法……令人质疑。

english: He's tasted power, and won't give it up easily.
chinese: 他已经尝到权力的好处，不会轻易放手。

english: But Shinja only rules because no one else will stand against the other clans.
chinese: 可 Shinja 能掌权，只因无人敢站出来对抗其他氏族。

english: Wolf and Lotus are tearing what's left of your father's empire apart.
chinese: 恶狼族和莲花族正在瓜分你父亲残存的帝国。

english: The people need a leader with Oja blood.
chinese: 人民需要一位拥有 Oja 家族血统的领袖。

english: Then you'll have to beat him.
chinese: 那你就得打败他。

english: Shinja rules two provinces from an old Serpent fort, here.
chinese: Shinja 从这里的一座灵蛇族旧堡垒统治着两个行省。

english: His tax collectors take most of what this village has...
chinese: 他派人收走了这个村子的大部分东西……

english: ...while his hired archers haunt the eastern road, stealing what little remains.
chinese: ……雇来的弓箭手又盘踞在东边道路，抢走仅剩的一点。

english: Break Shinja's forces and he'll lose his will to fight.
chinese: 击溃 Shinja 的部队，他就会失去斗志。

english: We have no soldiers, but the villagers stand ready to serve.
chinese: 我们没有士兵，但村民们愿意效力。

english: What shall we do?
chinese: 我们该怎么办？

english: And yet you kept fighting.
chinese: 可你还是坚持战斗。

english: Show respect!
chinese: 放尊重点！

english: Lord Oja would never have given the Orb to geisha!
chinese: Oja 大人绝不会把宝珠交给艺妓！

english: Every death here today saved two.
chinese: 今天这里每牺牲一人，就救下了两人。

english: No one could ask for more.
chinese: 没人能要求更多了。

english: They fight because they fear the Serpent clan.
chinese: 他们作战，是因为惧怕灵蛇族。

english: There are worse men you could be.
chinese: 你本来可能成为更坏的人。

english: Did you kill him?
chinese: 你杀了他吗？

english: Not to me.
chinese: 对我来说不是。

english: You know the legends.
chinese: 你知道那些传说。

english: He's all we have.
chinese: 他是我们唯一的希望。

english: I've never seen anyone move like that.
chinese: 我从未见过有人那样行动。

english: Impossible!  The Lotus clan tore Serpentholm apart stone by stone searching for the Orb!
chinese: 不可能！莲花族为了寻找宝珠，把 Serpentholm 一砖一石都拆了！

english: He's right, Lord.
chinese: 他说得对，大人。

english: If we abandon the villagers, they'll die.
chinese: 如果抛下村民，他们会死。

english: The Orb has been safe for seven years.
chinese: 宝珠已经安然无恙地藏了七年。

english: Only the geisha know where it is.
chinese: 只有艺妓知道它在哪里。

english: Bring them with us, and the Orb stays safe.
chinese: 带上她们，宝珠就能继续安全地藏着。

english: Smoke from the Dragon's Spire.
chinese: 神龙之塔升起了烟。

english: There's a village there.
chinese: 那里有一个村子。

english: If the Lotus soldiers are pillaging that far south, they've already got Serpentholm.
chinese: 如果莲花族士兵已经抢到那么靠南的地方，Serpentholm 恐怕也已失守。

english: What?
The dragon is telling us to hurry.
The other clans have come.
There's a lot of them.
A week ago these men were peasant farmers.
You've made warriors out of them, but the Lotus and Wolf soldiers are veterans.
Better that than seven years spent stealing from the very peasants who trusted us to protect them!
That...what is that?
Gone.
We tried to follow...
Are you sure?
Why does he want the Orb?
Shinja...
Why did I never see that before?
He'll come to his senses, Lord.
Let me go with you.
Kenji said...
No...the Wolf clan is beaten.
The Lotus wizards are the real enemy.
We must not let their army escape back to the high plateau.
Strike them while their backs are to the sea, and we'll finish them once and for all.
I'll live.
If you have something to say...
Kenji will kill you for this.
Show respect!
Even after your father's death, the geisha were thought untouchable...
The Orb may still be safe.
Don't listen to him, lord - this way is the safest.
Even though the Lotus have built an outpost there, the dense woods should mask our passage.
Putting out fires.
This is madness, Kenji.
We've driven these people from their homes.
You sound like your father.
Serpentholm is a ruin.
The Lotus wizards tore it down when the Serpent died.
Kenji, it doesn't matter.
Our enemies thought it was here.
We could push on to Serpentholm.
And the geisha?
What?  We can't...
But lord...they are many and we are few.
Perhaps we should withdraw.
Lost.
We tried to follow...
It wasn't human.  You saw...
You're mad!
Can't you see?
He's turned on his own people!
How many more can you kill before the clan is destroyed?
That's...
I serve the clan.
Please...let me help you start a village.
This is Sperri, one of the peasants you saved in the last province.
Select him.
What you now see at the bottom of the screen are the available buildings.
You can only build a peasant hut right now.
Left-click on the peasant hut icon, then place the hut by right-clicking somewhere on the ground.
chinese: 左键点击农舍图标，再在地面上选一处位置点击右键，建造农舍。

english: If you decide you don't want to build the hut right now, left-click to cancel or to select something else.
You can only build on relatively flat terrain, so plan carefully.
Excellent!
Remember, left-click is always cancel or select, and right-click always performs actions.
Look!  A new peasant has emerged from the hut we built.
Now your people need food.
Let's harvest some rice from that rice field over there.
Rice is the currency of this land and is used in all construction and training efforts.
Left-click one of the peasants, scroll to the rice field and right-click the rice field.
Rice is important indeed, but you’ll also need water.
A pond or stream like that one would do nicely.
Select a peasant, then scroll to the pond and right-click it.
Excellent!  We're almost ready to start building our army!
To train warriors, we'll need a Dojo.
Select a peasant.
Notice the Dojo is now available in the build menu.
Find a good spot and build the Dojo just like you built the peasant hut.
Now to train your first Spearman.
Select a peasant and right-click the Dojo.
Training Spearmen will cost you rice and water, so make sure some peasants keep harvesting.
Well done - we're on our way!
The bandits must have driven these people out.
But look - there's a peasant hut still standing!
We should rebuild this village and make it our own.
That's the last of them.
What?
No, but...
My uncle lived in this village.
The Lotus clan.
Look at the forest...how strange.
Kenji...is that you?
You've grown up.
He abuses your father's people.
His tax collectors take everything that's not nailed down, and...
Since your father's death, the clan has fallen apart.
Only to save the peasants from...
As you command.
Shinja's bandits drove these people out.
But look - there's still one peasant hut intact!
With your permission, I will claim it for the clan.
A new peasant has just emerged from the peasant hut.
Select him.
Now you see the buildings the peasant can construct for you.
At the moment, you can only build another peasant hut or a target range.
Left-click the target range icon, then right-click on the ground to place the new building.
You'll need additional rice and water to construct more buildings and train an army.
Select one peasant, then right-click on that rice field west of the village to begin harvesting rice.
There's also a stream to the north where we can obtain fresh water.
Send a peasant there as well.
Now that we have a stockpile of rice and water, we should begin training some archers.
Select a peasant, then right-click the target range.
Excellent!
We must be careful.
The high road is easier travelling, but we're sure to be spotted.
The forest would mask our movements until we're ready to attack.
Come out, you madman!
Face me!
You are your father's son...
